fact.en: Assuming Ashoka abandoned the army after Kalinga; he maintained it for security but favored non-aggression.
fact.hi: Assuming Ashoka abandoned the army after Kalinga; he maintained it for security but favored non-aggression.

fact.en: Confusing 'Dhamma' with Buddhism; Dhamma was an ethical code for social harmony, distinct from the tenets of Buddha.

fact.en: Attributing the fall of the empire solely to Ashoka's pacifism, ignoring economic and succession structural failures.
